properties.source: Schematic route drawn by hand along the legal Northern Sea Route (Kara Strait to the Bering Strait at Cape Dezhnev, ~5,600 km, per Wikipedia 'Northern Sea Route' and Russia's 2012 NSR water-area definition), via the Kara Sea, Vilkitsky Strait, Laptev Sea, Sannikov Strait, East Siberian Sea and Long Strait (general knowledge of the usual track). Checked to stay off Natural Earth 10m v5.1.2 (public domain) land. Split at 180 deg. Approximate: real tracks vary with ice.
refs: Natural Earth 10m v5.1.2 (public domain), commit f1890d9
